variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays to be rid of the wolves taking his sheep.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Wolves! Wolves out of the Ashwood, right down to my pens! They've had a good many of my sheep already, and they'll have the rest if somebody doesn't stop them.

Nobody hunts those woods anymore, not since Red Corwin's lot took the tower. Kill those wolves, lad, and I'll pay you what I can. What do you say?

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: They took another one last night! Hurry, lad!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
You did it? No more wolves? Ha! My poor sheep can graze in peace again!

Here's 75 gold, lad. You've earned every piece.

journal.text: Kill the wolves that are raiding Ulric's flock.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Grenda the mushroom farmer wants the Scorpions cleared out of her mushroom cave west of the market.

offer.speaker: Grenda
offer.text:
Scorpions! Scorpions in my mushroom cave! They came up out of the old tunnels when the dead started walking, and now they're eating my whole crop and stinging anybody who goes in there!

My cave is just west of the market. Kill the nasty things and I'll pay you well, I promise!

reminder.speaker: Grenda
reminder.text: Are they dead yet? I can hear them clicking from here!

completion.speaker: Grenda
completion.text: All dead? Oh, thank goodness! My poor mushrooms! Here, take this gold, kind sir. You've earned every piece of it.

journal.text: Kill the Scorpions in Grenda's mushroom cave.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Haskin, an old eel-catcher, wants the Giant Leeches killed in his eel ponds south of the village.

offer.speaker: Haskin
offer.text:
Bah! Leeches! Great big slimy ones, in my eel ponds south of the village! They've eaten every last eel and now they're starting on my nets!

Nothing's been right in this swamp since that Necromancer Ulgor came. You kill them Leeches and there's good gold in it for you.

reminder.speaker: Haskin
reminder.text: Are them Leeches dead yet? No? Then what are you doing here?

completion.speaker: Haskin
completion.text: Dead? All of 'em? Ha! Now that's good news for a change! Here's your reward -- 75 gold, and well earned.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in Haskin's eel ponds.

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Bodric, the castle cook, wants the Giant Leeches cleared out of the cistern under the kitchens.

offer.speaker: Bodric
offer.text:
Bah! Giant Leeches! The cistern under the kitchens is crawling with the slimy things! I sent the potboy down for a bucket of water and he came back up screaming, with leeches stuck all over his legs!

If Malgrith's dead ever lay siege to us, this castle will need every drop in that cistern. And the soldiers won't go near it!

Clear 'em out and I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Bodric
reminder.text: Well? Are they gone? I can't make soup without water!

completion.speaker: Bodric
completion.text: No more leeches? Ha! Thank you, lad! Here, take this gold. You earned every piece of it!

journal.text: Clear the Giant Leeches out of the cistern beneath the kitchens.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Gubby, an old fisherman, pays to have the Giant Leeches cleared out of the reed beds south of the village.

offer.speaker: Gubby
offer.text:
Leeches! Giant Leeches! They've moved into the reed beds south of the village and they eat every fish that goes in my nets. Ate half my net too, the greedy things.

Ever since that Necromancer came to Gorm Isle, every nasty thing in Lake Vell's been crawling up on our shore.

Kill them leeches for me and I'll make it worth your while, lad.

reminder.speaker: Gubby
reminder.text: Them leeches still out there? I can't fish with 'em about!

completion.speaker: Gubby
completion.text: Ha, ha! No more leeches! I'll have a full net by sundown! Here, take this gold. You earned every piece of it.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in the reed beds south of Ostra.

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Hobb, the College groundskeeper, wants the Leeches in his lily pond killed.

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text:
Leeches! Great big slimy Leeches, in my lily pond behind the College! Ever since that Necromancer came all kinds of nasty things crawl up out of the water.

They ate every last frog in there and bit one of the students on the leg. Kill 'em off for me and I'll pay you good gold, I promise you that.

reminder.speaker: Hobb
reminder.text: Are they dead yet? Well, what are you standing around here for?

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: They're gone? Really? Ha! Now maybe I can get some sleep. Here, 75 gold. You earned every piece of it!

journal.text: Kill the Leeches in Hobb's lily pond.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Dagny the cook: Bears dig into the fort's meat store behind the kitchen every night.

offer.speaker: Dagny
offer.text:
Bears! Big hungry Black Bears, in my meat store! They dig in through the snow behind the kitchen every night and eat the soldiers' supper!

The Warden won't spare me a single man, they're all up on the walls watching for the Undead. Kill those beasts and I'll pay you well, I promise!

reminder.speaker: Dagny
reminder.text: Hurry! There won't be a scrap of meat left for supper!

completion.speaker: Dagny
completion.text: You killed them? Ha! The soldiers will eat tonight! Here's your gold, a hundred pieces, just like I promised.

journal.text: Kill the Bears raiding Dagny's meat store behind the kitchen.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Mott the carter wants the Scorpions cleared out of the Slag Pits east of town so his mules will haul ore again.

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text:
Bah! Scorpions! The Slag Pits east of town are crawling with them. Ever since the Ogres took the Old Foundry, every kind of vermin is coming down off the mountain!

My mules won't go near the pits, and I've got ore to haul. Kill those Scorpions and I'll make it worth your while. That's fair, isn't it?

reminder.speaker: Mott
reminder.text: Are those Scorpions dead yet? I can't haul a thing!

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Dead? All of 'em? Ha! Wait till my mules hear about this! Here's 100 gold for you, stranger. You earned every piece.

journal.text: Kill the Scorpions in the Slag Pits for Mott.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Ossrik the swineherd wants the Bears out of the north woods driven off his pig farm.

offer.speaker: Ossrik
offer.text:
Bears! Big black ones, down out of the north woods! They've been at my pigs every night and they'll be at me next!

The Mayor won't spare me a man, not with Ravek's Undead at the gate. Drive those Bears off and I'll pay you what I can.

reminder.speaker: Ossrik
reminder.text: Are they gone yet? My poor pigs!

completion.speaker: Ossrik
completion.text: No more Bears? Ha! My pigs can sleep easy tonight, and so can I! Here, 80 gold. It's all I've got, but it's yours!

journal.text: Drive off the Bears raiding Ossrik's pig farm.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Gaffer Rudd, a cattle farmer, wants the Giant Leeches out of his cow pond south of the village.

offer.speaker: Gaffer Rudd
offer.text:
First the Ogres, and now Leeches! Great big slimy Leeches, crawled up out of the bog and into my cow pond! The cows won't go near the water and they've gone and stopped giving milk.

The pond's just past my barn, south of the village. You kill them horrid things and I'll pay you good gold for it, lad.

reminder.speaker: Gaffer Rudd
reminder.text: My poor cows! Have you killed them Leeches yet?

completion.speaker: Gaffer Rudd
completion.text: They're dead? All of 'em? Ha! The cows will be glad to hear it! Here, take this gold. You earned it.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in Gaffer Rudd's cow pond.
